description: One of two Impala Mk I airframes preserved at the INDLELA trade test centre, formerly COTT, as instructional and display airframes. The pair are ex-SAAF 486 (c/n 131/6362/A11) and 541 (c/n A66), but the photographer who recorded them on 25 September 2022 stated it was not possible to tell them apart, so no serial is assigned to this individual airframe. Serial deliberately left blank rather than guessed.
